intent: Site-visit requests from couples (hotels and halls only, A-10): a list inside Needs-you and More, a visit detail with confirm, propose another time and decline, the three-way group chat with the client and Ghazal support, the arrival confirmation and the venue's visit availability. Visits are free; they create no voucher effect. The chat has exactly three roles and is member-only (ADR 0033 D9).

screens.purpose: All visits by state: Requested (needs a reply), Upcoming and Past, ordered by the nearest slot. The place the hotel representative works from; also reachable from Today > Needs you.
interactions: Segmented control Requested (2) / Upcoming / Past; each card shows client first name, date, arrival window, visitors, note preview and the time since the request; Requested cards carry "Confirm" and "Propose another time" inline
Tapping a card opens the visit detail (HL-VIST-02); a badge on More counts requested visits; no swipe actions
Empty: "No visit requests. Clients can book a visit from your venue page."
screens.contentNotes: Cards (illustrative): ريم الدوسري / Reem Al-Dosari, Sat 14 Nov 2026, 5:00 PM - 5:30 PM, 2 visitors, note «الحفل النسائي، مع الوالدة»; نورة العلي, Sun 15 Nov, 6:00 PM. Roles: Admin, Manager and Reception reply; Accountant and Marketing do not see the screen.

screens.purpose: One visit: who, when, how many, what they asked, with the representative's actions (confirm, propose another time, decline), the assigned representative and the link into the group chat. Variant per status.
interactions: Sticky bar by status: Requested shows "Confirm" (gold), "Propose another time" and "Decline"; Confirmed shows "Open chat" and, on the day, "Mark arrived" (HL-VIST-04); Arrived shows "Complete visit"; Past shows none

Sections: client (first name, monogram, no phone unless shared), slot and visitors, the client's note, the assigned representative (editable by Admin and Manager), the three chat members as role chips, and a timeline of the visit
Decline asks for a reason chip (Not available, Venue closed, Other) and tells the client in the chat; confirming or proposing posts a system message in the group chat
Offline disables all decisions in place with a plain reason
screens.contentNotes: Header «زيارة · السبت 14 نوفمبر، 5:00 م» / "Visit · Sat 14 Nov, 5:00 PM". Assigned representative: Amal Al-Balushi (Reception). Missed can be flagged within 24 hours after the slot. A visit has no money.

screens.purpose: The dedicated group chat for the visit, seen by the hotel representative: the client, the hotel representative (you or a colleague with the visit permission) and a Ghazal support representative. Same chat component as the client (CL-VIST-03), with the representative's actions on the pinned card.
interactions: Pinned visit card with slot and status and the actions "Confirm", "Propose another time", "Mark arrived" by state; role chips for the three members in the header (member list in a sheet)

Messages carry the sender role chip (Client, Hotel, Support); the composer matches HL-TODY-05 (text, attach, voice); quick replies "We confirm your visit", "Please use the main entrance", "Parking is at the front"

Closes read-only 24 hours after the slot or immediately on decline or cancel; Admin and Manager can read every visit chat of the venue, other staff only those they are assigned to; support members cannot be removed or blocked
screens.contentNotes: System lines AR / EN mirror the client: «فُتحت محادثة الزيارة مع العميل ودعم غزل.» / "The visit chat is open with the client and Ghazal support." Participants are shown as monograms with role chips; no photos of people.

screens.purpose: On the day, confirm that the client arrived (or flag that they did not): the representative's half of the arrival confirmation that the client starts in the chat.
interactions: Two options: "Mark arrived" (posts "Welcome, {name}" system message and sets Arrived) and "Client did not arrive" (available from 30 minutes after the slot, flags Missed and informs support); the sheet shows the client's "on our way" status when sent
Missed can be corrected by Admin or Manager within 24 hours; completing the visit later closes the chat 24 hours after the slot
screens.contentNotes: Copy AR: «تأكيد وصول العميل» / "Mark client arrival"; «لم يحضر العميل» / "Client did not arrive". No penalty is applied to a client for a missed visit in the MVP.

screens.purpose: Set when visits can be requested: days, hours, slot length and a switch to turn visits off. Drives the slots clients see in CL-VIST-01. Admin and Manager only.
interactions: Master switch "Accept visit requests" (off hides Book a visit on the client venue detail); weekday rows with open and close times (Sunday-first, 12-hour clock) and a slot length chip (30 min default)
Optional "Assigned representative by default" picker from staff with the visit permission; "Blackout dates" opens the custom date sheet
Sticky "Save changes"; unsaved guard; offline disables Save in place
screens.contentNotes: Defaults (illustrative): Sun - Thu 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Fri and Sat 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM, 30-minute slots. Business hours (HL-SETT-05) are the outer bound.
